title: 第2360章 双线筹谋预判虫劫第2359章 莫凡布局避其锋芒
content_zh:
“此事，无需你多虑筹谋。”
莫凡语气陡然转沉，威严尽显，字字铿锵落地有声：“你若还认自己是朕的臣子、是我万古帝朝一员，便无条件信朕、信我万古帝朝的底蕴！”
玉符那头沉默一瞬，随即传来袁金刚无比坚定的应答，再无半分迟疑退缩：“微臣遵旨！”
“帝君再造之恩，微臣永世铭记！此生无论前路凶险几何、局势万变，微臣必肝脑涂地、万死不辞！”
“嗯。”
莫凡神色稍缓，淡淡吩咐道：“你只需安心潜伏，配合联军行事，定期传报情报即可。”
他唇角勾起一抹冷冽弧度，自信笃定：“这些域外势力看似底蕴滔天、兵强马壮，可真正愿意亲赴前线、浴血搏杀的中阶大圣，寥寥无几。
这一次，朕便亲自为他们掘一座埋骨之地！”
莫凡并未道出心底底牌。
无论袁金刚这枚暗棋是否起效，此战的主导权，自始至终都牢牢握在万古帝朝手中，从未旁落他人。
他也全然理解袁金刚的顾虑。
对方久离帝朝，不知如今万古帝朝坐拥空冥神国加持、底蕴早已今非昔比，心生忧患实属正常。
莫凡并未过多解释布局，也未透露任何战前谋划，只令袁金刚随机应变、静静蛰伏。
这既是对其心性与忠诚的最后考验，也是为了严守军机、杜绝泄密。
自此之后，莫凡双线并行、步步稳妥。
一面命妖网全程紧盯三域联军动向，一面密切追踪焚灵噬金镰虫潮轨迹，同时每日令龙二登台占卜，推演吉凶、排查凶险，务求万事周全、万无一失。
次日，妖网传讯如期而至。
此番不再是线下密报，小黄直接以传音玉符隔空禀报，讯息快捷隐秘。
“帝君，最新密报，焚灵噬金镰虫潮已横穿火域，冲入北山域地界，用不了数日，便可直抵漠北原！”
“虫潮过境声势滔天，三域联军心生忌惮，已然暂时避退、暂缓行军，不敢贸然前进。”

“暂缓行军？”莫凡眸底寒光一闪，冷笑洞穿人心：“他们哪里是畏惧虫潮，分明是想坐山观虎斗，等着我万古帝朝与虫潮两败俱伤，好坐收渔翁之利！”
念头落下，他语气稍缓，带着几分赞许开口：“你做得不错，短短时日，你便将妖网铺展至万域各处，情报通达、反应迅捷，远超朕当初的预期。”
“属下不敢居功。”小黄语气恭敬谦逊，“若无帝君倾力扶持、资源供给，属下纵有心思，也无半分建树。”
话音一转，他神色陡然凝重，郑重警示：“但帝君务必万分小心！此番虫潮凶险至极、前所未见！”
“据我妖网探查所见，虫潮过境寸草不生、万灵尽噬。
此前火域各大古族联手组建剿虫联盟，兵力浩瀚，可与虫潮交锋不过一个照面，便被尽数啃噬殆尽、尸骨无存。
甚至有一位大圣境强者来不及遁逃，陨落虫海！”
“属下已然推演完毕虫潮行进轨迹，不日便会侵入漠北原疆域！”
言罢，小黄将精准行进路线细细报备，为莫凡提前布局、从容应对争取足够时间。
结束传讯，莫凡即刻动身，心念一动裹挟龙二瞬移而出，转瞬抵达漠北原与北山域的交界天险。
此地脱离漠北原的燥热荒芜，一座座皑皑雪山拔地而起，冰川连绵万里、高耸入云，天然法则屏障横亘天地，硬生生隔绝两域疆域，是名副其实的绝境天险。
content_en:
"You don't need to worry about this matter."
Mo Fan's tone suddenly turned serious, showing his majesty, and every word was resounding: "If you still consider yourself to be my subject and a member of my Eternal Imperial Dynasty, then you will unconditionally believe in me and the heritage of my Eternal Imperial Dynasty!"
There was silence for a moment on the other end of the jade talisman, and then came Yuan Jingang's extremely firm response, without any hesitation or flinching: "I obey the order!"
"The emperor's kindness in rebuilding will be remembered by me forever! No matter how dangerous the road ahead is or the situation changes in this life, I will be heartbroken and will not hesitate to die!"
"Yeah."
Mo Fan's expression softened slightly and he calmly ordered: "You just need to lurk with peace of mind, cooperate with the coalition forces, and report information regularly."
The corner of his lips curled up with a cold arc, and he said confidently: "These extraterritorial forces may seem to have vast foundations and powerful soldiers, but there are only a few middle-level great saints who are truly willing to go to the front lines and fight bloody battles.
This time, I will personally dig a burial ground for them! "
Mo Fan did not reveal his innermost cards.
Regardless of whether Yuan Jingang's hidden chess move works or not, the dominance of this battle has been firmly in the hands of the Eternal Emperor from beginning to end, and has never been left to others.
He also completely understood Yuan Jingang's concerns.
The other party has been away from the imperial dynasty for a long time. I don't know that the eternal dynasty is now blessed by the Kingdom of Kongming, and its heritage is no longer what it used to be. It is normal to feel worried.
Mo Fan did not explain the layout too much, nor did he reveal any pre-war plans. He only asked Yuan Jingang to adapt to the situation and hibernate quietly.
This is not only the final test of his character and loyalty, but also to strictly guard military aircraft and prevent leaks.
Since then, Mo Fan has been working on two fronts in parallel, step by step.
On the one hand, the Demon Network keeps a close eye on the movements of the three-region coalition forces throughout the entire process, and on the other hand, it closely tracks the trajectory of the Soul-Burning Gold-eating Scythe. At the same time, Long Er is ordered to perform divination every day, deduce good and bad luck, and investigate dangers, so as to ensure that everything is comprehensive and foolproof.
The next day, the summons from the Demon Network arrived as scheduled.
This time it was no longer an offline secret report. Xiao Huang directly reported it through the air with the sound transmission jade talisman, and the message was fast and confidential.
"Emperor, the latest secret report is that the wave of soul-burning gold-devouring sickle insects has crossed the fire domain and rushed into the Beishan territory. It will not take a few days to reach the Mobei Plain!"
"The insect tide has passed through the border with such overwhelming force that the three-region coalition forces are wary. They have temporarily retreated and postponed their march, and they do not dare to advance rashly."
"Postponing the march?" Mo Fan's eyes flashed coldly, and his sneer penetrated people's hearts: "They are not afraid of the insect swarm. They clearly want to sit on the mountain and watch the tigers fight, waiting for both my Eternal Emperor and the insect swarm to suffer, so that they can reap the benefits!"
After the thought fell, he softened his tone slightly and spoke with some approval: "You have done a good job. In a short period of time, you have spread the demon network to all parts of the world. Your intelligence is clear and your response is quick, far exceeding my original expectations."
"My subordinates dare not take credit." Xiao Huang said in a respectful and humble tone, "Without the emperor's full support and resource supply, my subordinates will not achieve anything even if they are thoughtful."
As soon as his voice changed, his expression suddenly became solemn, and he solemnly warned: "But the emperor must be extremely careful! This insect wave is extremely dangerous and unprecedented!"
“According to what we can see through our demon net’s investigation, the insect tide passes through and no grass grows, and all souls are devoured.
Previously, all the major ancient tribes in the Fire Territory had joined forces to form an insect-suppressing alliance. Their troops were huge, but they could fight against the insect tides before they were all eaten away, leaving no bones left.
There was even a powerful person in the Great Saint Realm who had no time to escape and fell into the sea of insects! "
"My subordinates have already deduced the trajectory of the insect tide, and they will invade the territory of Mobei Plain in the near future!"
After saying that, Xiao Huang will report the precise route in detail to buy enough time for Mo Fan to plan ahead and deal with it calmly.
After the interrogation was over, Mo Fan set off immediately. A thought in his mind led Long Er to teleport out, and in an instant he arrived at the natural boundary between Mobei Plain and Beishan Domain.
This place is separated from the heat and desolation of the Mobei Plain. Snow-capped mountains rise from the ground. Glaciers stretch for thousands of miles and tower into the clouds. The natural law barrier stretches across the sky and the earth, forcibly cutting off the two territories. It is a veritable natural danger.
